riders.note: Royal Demon Rose. Reach weapons should not trigger this; the roses cannot tell.

description.value:
♓ The Pisces Cloth. [OFFENSE]

Cloth Passive — Royal Demon Rose

Roses grow from your Cloth. You are immune to poison. Any creature that touches you or hits you with an unarmed or non-reach melee attack takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Piranha Rose]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Royal Demon Rose]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Fog]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Royal Funeral]

Ascendant Boon — The Royal Demon Rose Garden [OFFENSE]

10-foot emanation. At the end of each of your turns, enemies inside must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or take @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and become enfeebled 1 (cumulative to enfeebled 4). Cap 4 creatures.

This requires that you acted hostilely that turn. The emanation persists even while you are unconscious.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Pisces)]

Zenith Boon — The Royal Demon Rose Garden (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon with a 15-foot emanation and @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage per turn.

Plus Bloody Rose once per minute ◆◆ (incapacitation, death): 60 feet, one creature, Fortitude save; on a failure @Damage[10d6[poison]] damage and enfeebled 2, on a critical failure it dies.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Pisces)]
